executiveSummary: Active exploitation of remote access and edge appliances continues: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day (CVE-2026-104935) is being used for unauthenticated RCE and pivoting; immediate patching, rebuilds, and credential rotation are urged. Security Advisory Direct OT impact observed in France: internet-exposed refrigeration controllers (Danfoss/Copeland/Dixell) were compromised, with national exposure rapidly taken offline; operators should remove public access, patch, and verify setpoints/alarms. Security Advisory View Article CISA warns of active, AI-assisted targeting of Siemens S7 PLCs via S7comm (TCP/102), emphasizing strict segmentation, access protection, and monitoring for snap7-based activity. Security Advisory Critical OT gateways at risk: multiple unauthenticated RCE and missing-authentication flaws in Advantech EKI-1242 series and publicly exploitable RCE on WISE-6610 LoRaWAN gateways enable takeover and network pivoting. Supporting Report Supporting Report BeyondTrust Remote Support authentication bypass is under active exploitation by a PRC-linked actor; patch immediately (BT26-05-RS) and assess for persistence, credential theft, and lateral movement. Security Advisory View Article F5 BIG-IP APM (OAuth AS) and Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway face in-the-wild exploitation for unauthenticated RCE; prioritize patching, limit exposure, and review for compromise. Security Advisory Security Advisory Active exploitation and reconnaissance across U.S. critical infrastructure attributed to Chinese-state-linked operators combining VPN abuse, botnets, and living-off-the-land tradecraft; initiate targeted threat hunting. Security Advisory Supply-chain compromise: AOMEI Backupper update servers were briefly hijacked in multiple windows to deliver backdoors and harvest NetNTLMv2; review April-July telemetry and block IOCs. View Article Manufacturing risk: ransomware operators weaponized Active Directory GPOs to disrupt Windows endpoints without deploying an encryptor; audit domain-root GPO changes and clean SYSVOL. Vendor Advisory Additional watch items: Danfoss iC7 drives insecure update paths; Oracle PeopleSoft mass exploitation by ShinyHunters; multiple OT-adjacent CVE clusters in Citrix/Tomcat/SANnav; monitor for knock-on effects and patch where feasible. Supporting Report View Article Focus: Remote access/VPN gateways Focus: OT device exposure Theme: IT→OT pivot risk Theme: Supply-chain

relevance: The current threat landscape features concurrent pressure on OT device exposure and the enterprise-OT boundary. Multiple actively exploited edge devices (Ivanti Connect Secure, F5 BIG-IP APM, Citrix NetScaler) and remote support tooling (BeyondTrust) materially increase the likelihood of IT-to-OT pivoting. Direct OT impacts are confirmed in refrigerated retail/cold-chain facilities, and CISA warns of active targeting against Siemens S7 PLCs over S7comm. Critical mitigation themes: remove OT device internet exposure, harden and monitor remote access pathways, and ensure strict zoning with authenticated conduits between IT and OT per IEC 62443.

descriptions: Initial access: Exploit Public-Facing Application (T1190) on VPN/ADC/WAF; Auth Bypass; Path Traversal
Credential access: Webshells; cookie/token theft; bt-secrets CLI; NetNTLMv2 harvesting via WebDAV
Lateral movement: RDP/SMB/WinRM (T1021); Impacket atexec; dev tunnels; MQTT/Matrix C2 in IIoT contexts
Persistence/Privilege escalation: SUID backdoors; service installs; GPO modification (T1484.001)
Defense evasion: Log wiping; URL-encoding WAF bypass; unsigned firmware/application loading on OT devices
Exfiltration: Cloud storage (Mega, OneDrive/SharePoint); covert tunnels

outlook72h: Expect opportunistic exploitation against unpatched Ivanti, BeyondTrust, F5, and NetScaler appliances; increase perimeter telemetry and alerting on abnormal auth/session activity. High likelihood of continued probing of internet-exposed OT endpoints (refrigeration controllers, gateways, PLCs); validate that no OT devices are publicly reachable. Monitor for lateral movement from edge devices into AD, file shares, and engineering workstations; pre-stage isolation playbooks for OT jump hosts. Coordinate with facilities and operations to verify cold-chain and safety-critical setpoints; prepare manual overrides and vendor engagement if anomalies detected.
